route_source: Shortest connected modeled walk across eligible mapped entrances at both buildings, using the frozen November 1 NC State GIS network plus a November 10 Bilyeu–Pullen pedestrian supplement. The supplement records OpenStreetMap footways and crossings corroborated with Raleigh sidewalk data and public aerial imagery, including an explicitly approximate 24.1 m marked-crossing/curb-approach trace. Road centerlines and city MissingSidewalk features are excluded; the Pullen bridge is not connected to Western Boulevard underneath. Nine existing manual housing access paths and fallback entrance connectors are preserved. Public access, door hours, October-specific closures and crossing delay are not verified.
